name: RNAEdit
title: RNA editing model

args.name: edits
args.description: Map from genomic nucleotide to RNA product

args.name: rnaRate
args.description: Multiplier for substitution rates that change the RNA product

description:
Construct a substitution model whose states pair a genomic nucleotide with its RNA product. The edits map specifies the RNA product for each edited nucleotide; omitted nucleotides are unchanged. Only states consistent with this map have nonzero root frequencies or substitution rates.

Rates come from the genomic nucleotide model. Substitutions that also change the RNA product are multiplied by rnaRate. The RNA-edit alphabet supports C-to-U and U-to-C editing, with T replacing U for DNA.

Stationary inputs produce stationary models. Non-equilibrium inputs retain their root frequencies, mapped onto the editing states.
examples: HKY85 +> RNAEdit({"C":"U"})           # C-to-U editing with an RNA alphabet
